changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_epreuves_discipline
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_epreuves_categorie
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_epreuves_date_heure
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS swim_style VARCHAR(50)
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gender VARCHAR(10)
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS round VARCHAR(50)
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_date DATE
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'PLANIFIEE'
ALTER TABLE epreuves ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS distance_str VARCHAR(100)
UPDATE epreuves SET swim_style = style WHERE swim_style IS NULL AND style IS NOT NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET gender = sexe WHERE gender IS NULL AND sexe IS NOT NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET scheduled_date = DATE(date_heure) WHERE scheduled_date IS NULL AND date_heure IS NOT NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET status = 'PLANIFIEE' WHERE status IS NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET distance_str = CAST(distance AS VARCHAR) WHERE distance_str IS NULL AND distance IS NOT NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET swim_style = 'NAGE_LIBRE' WHERE swim_style IS NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET gender = 'M' WHERE gender IS NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE scheduled_date IS NULL
UPDATE epreuves SET distance_str = '0' WHERE distance_str IS NULL
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS nom
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS discipline
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS categorie
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS sexe
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS distance
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS style
ALTER TABLE epreuves DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS date_heure
ALTER TABLE epreuves RENAME COLUMN distance_str TO distance
ALTER TABLE epreuves ALTER COLUMN swim_style SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE epreuves ALTER COLUMN gender SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE epreuves ALTER COLUMN scheduled_date SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE epreuves ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE epreuves ALTER COLUMN distance SET NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_epreuves_swim_style ON epreuves(swim_style)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_epreuves_scheduled_date ON epreuves(scheduled_date)
